query:
SELECT el.id AS "id!", el.deleting_at IS NOT NULL AS "deleting!"
        FROM email_links el
        WHERE el.macro_id = $1
        UNION
        SELECT el.id, el.deleting_at IS NOT NULL
        FROM email_links el
        JOIN macro_user_links mul ON el.id = mul.link_id
        WHERE mul.primary_macro_id = $1
